field_notes.game_cultural_victory_flag: Raw GAME flag. The same record enables default victory conditions, so this flag alone does not establish the effective standard-game setting.
field_notes.game_retain_culture_on_capture: Raw GAME.RetainCulture scenario property. The installed Conquests readme says MPTournament enables captured-city culture retention; the detailed per-civilization accounting effect is not established.
field_notes.government_interactions: Raw GOVT pair fields follow the adjacent parser schema. Resistance percentage-point use matches CivFanatics for six base governments; Conquests-only Fascism/Feudalism application is inferred.
field_notes.race_culture_group_index: Raw RACE index; keep separate from accumulated culture-point rules.
field_notes.difficulty: Raw DIFF settings are exported for checking potential difficulty effects. No field is treated as a culture modifier without supporting evidence.
